_databaseNote: Development runs against a local PostgreSQL so the schema, the enum-to-string conversions and the history queries behave exactly as they do in production. Override the credentials with user-secrets rather than editing this file: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Postgres" "..."

Jwt._secretNote: Dev-only signing key. NEVER reuse in production — set Jwt__Secret via env var / user-secrets there.
